City Council and Successor Agency Regular Meetings
AGENDA
MEETING OF
THE LA PUENTE CITY COUNCIL AND
SUCCESSOR AGENCY
COUNCIL CHAMBERS
15900 EAST MAIN STREET, LA PUENTE
MAY 24, 2022
07:00
P.M.
5-24-22 Agenda
CALL TO ORDER
ROLL CALL
COUNCIL/AGENCY MEMBERS: Klinakis, Munoz, Argudo, Mendoza, and Quinones
PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE
PRESENTATIONS
Presentation of Proclamation to Looms4Lupus Declaring May 2022 as Lupus and Fibromyalgia Awareness Month
Presentation by Los Angeles County Department of Public Works on the Bassett High School Multi-Benefit Stormwater Capture Project
Presentation of Certificates of Recognition to Lan Truong and Erik Deurmeier of Union Station Homeless Services
Presentation by Los Angeles County Department of Public Works on the Bassett High School Multi-Benefit Stormwater Capture Project
Presentation by Los Angeles County Department of Public Works on the Bassett High School Multi-Benefit Stormwater Capture Project
ORAL COMMUNICATIONS
If you wish to address the City Council/Successor Agency on an item other than a public hearing matter, complete the Request for Oral Presentation form and submit it to the City Clerk no later than prior to the conclusion of the first speaker's remarks. All speakers are requested to observe the City's Rules of Decorum when addressing the City Council. (LPMC section 2.04.120.)
BOARDS/COMMISSION/COMMITTEE REPORTS
Council Members provide a report on any Boards/Commission/Committee meetings, listed below, that they have attended or that have occurred.
A.
MINUTES OF PREVIOUS CITY COUNCIL AND SUCCESSOR AGENCY MEETINGS
A-1
READ AND APPROVE THE MINUTES OF THE CITY COUNCIL AND SUCCESSOR AGENCY MEETING OF MAY 10, 2022
It is recommended that the City Council and Successor Agency waive the reading and approve the Minutes of the City Council and Successor Agency meeting of May 10, 2022.
A-1 Minutes 5-10-22 CC SA
B.
PUBLIC HEARINGS BEFORE THE CITY COUNCIL – None
C.
UNFINISHED BUSINESS OF THE CITY COUNCIL – None
D.
CITY COUNCIL AND SUCCESSOR AGENCY CONSENT CALENDAR
All matters listed under Consent Calendar are considered to be routine in nature and may be enacted by one motion approving the recommendation listed on the Agenda. One or more items may be removed from the Consent Calendar so that said item(s) may be discussed and considered individually by the City Council/Successor Agency, if a motion to remove the item(s) is approved by an affirmative vote of a majority of the members of the City Council/Successor Agency. Those specific item(s) will be considered as the first item under New Business.
D-1
CONSIDERATION OF A RESOLUTION APPROVING WARRANT REGISTER NO. 1530
It is recommended that the City Council and Successor Agency adopt Resolution No. 22-5721 approving Warrant Register No. 1530.
D-1 Warrant Register #1530
D-2
PRESENTATION OF APRIL 2022 REQUISITION SUMMARY REPORT
It is recommended that the City Council receive and file this report.
D-2 April Requisition Summary Staff Report
D-2 April Requisition Summary Attachment A Report
D-3
PRESENTATION OF APRIL 2022 INVESTMENT REPORT
It is recommended that the City Council receive and file this report.
D-3 April Investment Report Staff Report
D-3 April Investment Report Attachments A-E Reports
D-4
CONSIDERATION OF A RESOLUTION SETTING A PUBLIC HEARING DATE FOR THE DESIGNATION OF AN UNDERGROUND UTILITY DISTRICT IN THE CITY
It is recommended the City Council adopt Resolution No. 22-5722 setting June 14, 2022 as the date to conduct a public hearing to consider the establishment of an underground utility district along Amar Road from Orange Avenue to Sunset Avenue.
D-4 Rule 20A Set Public Hearing Staff Report
D-4 Rule 20A Set Public Hearing Attachment A Resolution
D-5
CONSIDERATION OF ACCEPTANCE OF NOTICE OF COMPLETION FOR MAINTENANCE YARD ACCESS ROAD AT LA PUENTE PARK
It is recommended that the City Council: (1) accept the project as complete; and (2) authorize the City Clerk to execute the Notice of Completion.
D-5 TOWO Maintenance Yard Access Road NOC Staff Report
D-5 TOWO Maintenance Yard Access Road NOC Attachment A NOC
D-6
CONSIDERATION OF A RESOLUTION DESIGNATING THE ENTITIES PERMITTED TO SELL SAFE AND SANE FIREWORKS IN THE CITY FOR 2022
It is recommended that the City Council adopt Resolution No. 22-5723 designating the entities permitted to sell safe and sane fireworks in the City.
D-6 Safe and Sane Fireworks Staff Report
D-6 Safe and Sane Fireworks Attachment A Resolution
D-7
CONSIDERATION OF REJECTION OF ALL BIDS FOR THE BUS SHELTER REPLACEMENT/INSTALLATION PROJECT AT VARIOUS LOCATIONS IN THE CITY AND AUTHORIZATION TO RE-ADVERTISE THE PROJECT
It is recommended that the City Council: (1) reject all bids received for the Bus Shelter Replacement/Installation Project at various locations in the City; and (2) authorize Staff to re-advertise and solicit bids for the Project.
D-7 Bus Shelter Replacement Bid Reject Staff Report
D-8
CONSIDERATION OF AN AGREEMENT BETWEEN ZENCITY TECHNOLOGIES AND THE CITY FOR COMMUNICATIONS MANAGEMENT SERVICES
It is recommended that the City Council: (1) adopt Resolution No. 22-5716 adopting findings to dispense with the competitive bidding process for an Agreement with Zencity Technologies; (2) approve the Agreement with Zencity Technologies and (3) authorize the City Manager to execute the Agreements on behalf of the City.
D-8 Zencity Communication Services Staff Report
D-8 Zencity Communication Services Attachment A Agreement
D-8 Zencity Communication Services Attachment B Resolution
E.
NEW BUSINESS TO BE CONSIDERED BY THE CITY COUNCIL
E-1
PRESENTATION OF APRIL 2022 BUDGET REPORT
It is recommended that the City Council receive and file this report.
E-1 April Budget Report Staff Report
E-1 April Budget Report Attachment A Report
E-2
CONSIDERATION OF AUTHORIZATION FOR THE LA PUENTE COMMUNITY FOUNDATION TO HOST A BEER GARDEN AT THE FORTUNATO JIMENEZ INDEPENDENCE DAY CELEBRATION
It is recommended that the City Council authorize the La Puente Community Foundation to host a beer garden at the Fortunato Jimenez Independence Day Celebration on July 3, 2022.
E-2 July 3 Beverage Garden Staff Report
E-2 July 3 Beverage Garden Attachment A Site
E-2 July 3 Beverage Garden Attachment B Rules
ADHOC COMMITTEE REPORTS
Council Members provide a report on any Ad Hoc Committee meetings that they have attended.
ORAL COMMENTS FROM COUNCIL
AB 1234 REPORTS
ORAL COMMENTS FROM COUNCIL
ORAL COMMENTS FROM STAFF
ADJOURNMENT
AVAILABILITY
Any writings or documents provided to a majority of the City Council/Successor Agency regarding any item on this agenda will be made available for public inspection during normal business hours at City Hall located at 15900 E. Main Street, the La Puente Community Center located at 501 North Glendora and the Los Angeles County Library located at 15920 E. Central. In addition, such writings and documents will be posted on the City's website at http://www.lapuente.org.
AMERICANS WITH DISABILITIES
In compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act, if you need special assistance to participate in a City meeting or other services offered by the City, please contact the City Clerk's Office at (626) 855-1500. Notification at least 48 hours prior to the meeting or time when services are needed will assist City staff in assuring that reasonable arrangements can be made to provide accessibility to the meeting or service.
MEETING TIMES
Meetings of the City Council shall be adjourned no later than 10:30 p.m., unless a motion to supersede the 10:30 time limit to consider some or all of the remaining items listed on the Agenda, or to consider items which have been added to the Agenda in accordance with the provisions of the Ralph M. Brown Act, Government Code Section 54950, et seq., is approved by a majority of the members of the City Council. (Ordinance No. 95-727).
CERTIFICATION
I hereby certify under penalty of perjury, under the laws of the State of California that the foregoing agenda was posted in accordance with the applicable legal requirements.
Dated this 19th day of May 2022
